# MaxVideoAI

MaxVideoAI helps a producer plan a launch film, compare current models, budget each shot, and review a quote before approving a paid generation. The workflow keeps the brief, references, and decisions connected so a project can move from an early idea to a useful production plan. A team can review the scope, choose a model for the intended motion, and keep the work grounded in the creative decision rather than an abstract feature list. The result is designed to make practical production work easier to discuss with collaborators while the project retains a clear next step. When the plan changes, the producer can revise the brief, compare alternatives again, and decide whether the revised price suits the project. A completed result can remain in the MaxVideoAI library, where it is available for later review, recovery, or reuse alongside the references that informed it. ## Plan a production

Start with the brief and identify the intended audience, format, and delivery context before comparing model options.

## Compare model options

Review the capability and price information that matters for the current production decision.

## Approve the spend

Confirm the quote when it fits the budget and keep the project moving.
